facts.text: I have been having issues with my pleco lately.
My pleco looks a bit bloated.
I am worried I might have overfed my pleco.
I have been keeping track of my water parameters.
My pH has been fluctuating from 7.4 to 7.8 over the past month.
I have been keeping aquariums for about 6 months.
I have been trying to get a handle on water changes and monitoring my tank's parameters.
I recently switched to Hikari pellets.
My fish seem to be enjoying Hikari pellets more.
I have been feeding my fish frozen brine shrimp every Friday evening.
My fish absolutely love the frozen brine shrimp.
I think I will try mixing live and frozen brine shrimp first.
I am considering adding vegetable matter to their diet, like spirulina or zucchini.
